fields.name: Nandana (disciple of Rasikānanda)
fields.notes:
A disciple of Rasikānanda Prabhu (Rasika-maṅgala, Paścima 14.151; the Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna: 14.159).

The record also held the poet Nandana and the life of Nandana Ācārya of Navadvīpa (in whose house Nityānanda first stayed): now in their own records (07-11-2026).

fields.name: Kāśīnātha Paṇḍita (of Navadvīpa)
fields.notes:
The brāhmaṇa of Navadvīpa who arranged the marriage of Lord Gaurāṅga with Viṣṇupriyā Devī (Caitanya-bhāgavata Ādi 15.51-66; Bhakti-ratnākara 12.1381; Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna).

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Kulaka, the brāhmaṇa sent by Satrājit to arrange Satyabhāmā's marriage (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 50).

Not Kāśīnātha (Kāśīśvara) Paṇḍita of Cātarā (1420-1486 Śaka), whose life this record also held: it is now in his record «Kāśīśvara Paṇḍita (Gaura-Govinda)» #1832 (07-11-2026).

fields.notes: A devotee of Lord Caitanya who played the rāmasiṅgā (a horn of buffalo horn); when the Lord came back to Purī from South India he welcomed Him playing it. Taken out of the record «Balarāma Dās» #81 (07-11-2026).
An Oriyā brāhmaṇa, disciple of Śrīnivāsa Ācārya (Karṇānanda 2). Taken out of the record «Balarāma Dās» #81 (07-11-2026).

Of Orissa, a devotee of Lord Caitanya, the second son of Kānāi Khuṇṭiyā (Vaiṣṇava-vandanā); some say Kānāi Khuṇṭiyā worshipped Baladeva and Jagannātha as his sons (Bhakti Movement in Orissa p. 79). Taken out of the record «Balarāma Dās» #81 (07-11-2026).
The younger brother of Śyāmānanda Prabhu (Rasika-maṅgala, Pūrva 2.36). Taken out of the record «Balarāma Dās» #81 (07-11-2026).
The eldest son of Gaurīdāsa Paṇḍita. Taken out of the record «Balarāma Dās» #81 (07-11-2026).
